pages.observation: Each tier holds one balloon or caption, so the order is unambiguous: Meera explains, then Ravi asks, then Meera answers, then the caption. Each question gets an answer that is not skipped: Ravi's 'So I can...?' is answered by 'That's the idea.' The middle tier is two panels side by side, and the left one clearly comes first. The two balloons are far enough apart that a reader will not jump from the first tier straight to the right-hand panel. Each tail points to the intended speaker box: tier 1 to meera, middle-left to ravi, middle-right down to meera. The 'WELBUK HEALTH for patients' label sits directly under Ravi's balloon. It reads as a sign or label rather than speech, and it touches the left panel border. In the right-hand panel, Ravi has only a marker at the edge and his name label crosses the panel border. That is a layout artefact. The bottom tier jumps from 'Let's walk through...' to a closing caption with no transition text. The walkthrough itself is skipped, and only the caption bridges the time and place change. No text is illegible. The tier-4 placeholder name is clipped to 'anany'.

pages.observation: Reading order is clear: explanation, question, answer, then the closing caption. No reply is skipped. Each tail goes to the correct speaker: tier 1 to the braided woman, middle-left to the bearded man, middle-right down to the braided woman. The text is legible throughout. Contacts: (a) In tier 1, the balloon's right edge (page x about 297) sits against or within a few pixels of the outer strands of the woman's hair, and the tail tip runs into her hair just in front of her ear and earring. It stays left of her face, but it touches her hair. (b) In the middle-left panel, the balloon's right edge is about 9 px from the man's hair, and the tail tip ends at his temple, just outside his face. The 'WELBUK HEALTH for patients' label is clear of both his gripping hand on the phone's left edge and the phone itself, by a gap of roughly 5-8 px. It covers only background (the monitor, a plant and the seated patients' chairs). (c) In the middle-right panel, the balloon's lower-right rounded corner (page about x 945-958, y 670-694) meets or nearly meets the top of the man's hair at the right edge. This is a possible contact with his hair. (d) In the bottom panel, the caption's right end (x about 672) sits close to the raised waving hand (x about 675 and up) but appears not to touch it. The caption also hides the left part of the awning, and the faces in the doorway are clear below it. The phone screens show only icons and blocks, with no readable text. Narrative: the jump from 'Let's walk through...' to the outdoor farewell skips the walkthrough. The caption makes this understandable as an ellipsis, but it is abrupt.

observations: I looked at works/auto-6294ee8a2094/assets/panels/07-1.png, works/auto-6294ee8a2094/assets/characters/main-cast.png and the composed page works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-07.png myself with Read. Meera matches the reference sheet: large round eyes with a lower lash line, thin high-arched brows, a round face, a silver hoop earring, a blue kurta with a white leaf motif, and a braid hanging in front over her left shoulder. Her right arm crosses to point its index finger at the phone, and the silver bangle is on that right wrist. Her left hand rests flat on the desk. This matches production.hands.meera.

Ravi matches the reference: thick straight brows close to the eyes, narrow smiling eyes, a trimmed beard on a square jaw, a side-parted short black hair and a light green shirt with rolled sleeves. He holds the phone (dark blue case, back toward the viewer, screen not visible) in his right hand, and his left hand rests on the desk edge with the wristwatch. This matches the production record and the heldBy value ravi.right.

Props and background: the phone shows only its back, so there is no screen text. The reception monitor is seen from behind, with no screen content. The wall picture is abstract. The seated patients are seen from behind through the window. No letters, logos or numbers appear in the art. The shoulder bag hangs from his left shoulder at his left hip. Bag side on the reference sheet: the strap is on his right shoulder. The page-07 panels do not stay on one side either: 07-4 is worn crossbody. Production does not specify a side, so I note it rather than block on it.

Composite: Meera's balloon is in the blank top-left wall area. Its right edge abuts her outer hair strands, and the tail tip ends in her hair in front of her ear, outside the face box. The protected phone and pointing finger are clear. The lettering stage should check the hair contact.
